caption_claim: FocalSwap turns attribution ambiguity into a fixed-row intervention test whose conclusion names the intervention, control, and evidence layer.
core_conclusion: The same ranking gain admits different source explanations; fixed-row interventions separate positive calibration, unestablished positive latest-slot contribution, and control-sensitive all-source signed contribution.

caption_claim: Opportunity, specificity, and deployable gate evidence remain separated across regimes, with local specificity distinguished from broad evidence.
core_conclusion: KuaiSAR and Qilin differ in opportunity surface; Qilin has a low-coverage local taxonomy subset, but neither establishes stable wide-coverage focal-transfer evidence.
statistics: bootstrap CI where available; shuffled-null p95/p99 thresholds

caption_claim: Broad matched buckets stay near placebo; tax>=4 is the only Holm-stable row in the ten-bucket family and is a low-coverage local pocket.
core_conclusion: Qilin broad matched buckets remain near placebo, while only a low-coverage taxonomy bucket survives multiplicity.

caption_claim: Latest-slot contribution intervals cross zero, while the positive all-source C0 contribution is control-sensitive on fixed UniSAR rows.
core_conclusion: Positive latest-slot contribution is not established, while UniSAR's positive all-source C0 neutral-mask contribution disappears under the C1 and C2 observed-support donors on the same rows.
